name: Moong Dal Dhokla
steps: Soak moong dal for 4 hours, drain and blend with the measured water until smooth. Mix in curd, sugar, turmeric and salt.
Grease a 20 cm shallow steaming tin with a little oil. Bring water to a boil in a steamer; the water must remain below the tin.
Fold fruit salt into the batter immediately before steaming. Transfer to the tin, filling no deeper than about 3 cm, and place in the hot steamer.
Steam covered for 18–22 minutes without opening during the first 15 minutes. A skewer inserted in the centre should come out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes and cut into squares. Heat remaining oil, pop mustard seeds and add curry leaves; take off the heat and carefully mix in lemon juice and 60 ml drinking water.
Spoon the tempering evenly over the cut dhokla and let it absorb for 5 minutes. Finish with chopped coriander and serve.
tips: For moong dal dhokla allow 4 hours soaking separately. Activate fruit salt only when the steamer is ready.
passiveTime: Allow additional soaking, resting, chilling or fermentation as specified in the steps.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
